newsitem.title: USA: Linens 'n Things registers stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Linens 'n Things registers stock offering.

text.p: Linens 'n Things Inc said Friday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission covering a proposed public offering of 5.25 million shares of its common stock.
All of the shares will be sold by Nashua Hollis CVS Inc, a unit of CVS Corp, the company said.
Credit Suisse First Boston will manage the underwriting syndicate for the proposed offering, the company said.
Linens 'n Things said it will not receive any proceeds from the proposed sale.
